title: Yograjloh
description: Yograjloh merges the foundational strength-building elements of Yograj herbs with pure iron for comprehensive joint and blood support. This classical formulation treats joint pain through anti-inflammatory herbal action combined with iron supplementation. Addresses arthritis through improved circulation and reduced inflammation. Supports nerve weakness patients with poor blood count through dual action.
